stepTitle: Residual vector e has the same dimension as the parameter vector $$\theta_{hat}$$.
stepBody: Sarah fits an OLS model to predict the number of students $$num_{students}$$ at MLK Student Union using the humidity level (humidity) and time of day (time) as predictors. Her fitted model is: $$num_{students,hat}$$ $$=$$ $$\theta_0$$ + $$\theta_1 humidity$$ + $$\theta_2 time$$. After fitting the optimal model, Sarah examines the residual vector e $$=$$ Y - $$Y_{hat}$$. Determine whether the statement is True or False. For each statement, indicate whether it is True or False.
